如何確認我的手機支援 eSIM？: How do I check if my phone supports eSIM?
在撥號介面輸入 *#06#，出現 EID 序號即代表支援 eSIM；也可在「設定: Dial *#06#. If an EID number appears, your phone supports eSIM. You can also check Settings > Cellular for an "Add eSIM" option. Make sure your phone is not carrier-locked before purchasing.
天數如何計算、什麼時候開始生效？: How are days counted and when does the plan start?

可以，所有方案均支援個人熱點，流量與主裝置共用；無限流量方案依公平使用原則提供高: Yes. All plans support personal hotspot, sharing the allowance with your main device. Unlimited plans provide high-speed data under a fair-use policy.

請確認已開啟「資料漫遊」，並將 eSIM 設為行動資料線路；若仍無法連線，可透過: Make sure Data Roaming is on and the eSIM is set as your cellular data line. If it still won't connect, contact 24/7 support in the KKday app.
